thread:
maria: Quick sync — after the incident yesterday I sketched a compact remediation plan. Proposals: 1) tighten SLO alert windows (30d -> 14d) for latency so we detect regressions faster, 2) add a dedicated 'latency hotpath' dashboard that shows p50/p95/p99 + error budget burn, 3) create recurring incident rule for the tail we saw. Need owners and timelines.

leo: Agree with the shorter window for regression detection. Concern: changing the window affects error budget math and historical trends. Can we add a note in the postmortem that we recalculated burn rates? :+1:

anika: I can own the SLO config change (monitoring repo). Will open a PR and add smoke tests for error-budget calc. Target: PR by Tue EOD.

dave: I'll build the dashboard. Plan: panels for p50/p95/p99 latency, QPS, and a single burn-rate sparkline. Will include threshold annotations for current SLO and a toggle to view 14d vs 30d. ETA Wed noon.

opsbot: incident-bot: postmortem created: PM-2026-04-12 (link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-04-12)

anika: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/monitoring/pull/42 — includes new SLO YAML and unit test for error budget formula. Need review from infra-team and telemetry.

sam: Quick flag — finance wants a heads-up if SLO changes lead to more alerts from Dedicated customers (could increase support load). @maria can you confirm before we flip?

maria: Noted. We'll gate the SLO rollout behind a short runbook and a customer-impact review. Action items below.

maria: ACTIONS: 1) anika -> open SLO config PR (due Tue EOD) 2) dave -> dashboard + panels (due Wed 12:00) 3) leo -> update postmortem notes with recalculated error budget & rationale (due Tue) 4) sam -> coordinate finance/customer comms (due Thu) 5) ops -> add recurring alert rule and link to postmortem (due Fri)

leo: For the dashboard query, I'm adding a simple rolling-bucket metric snippet to the panel:```
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",le!="+Inf"}[5m])) by (le)
```Will add an error-budget burn calc using rate of SLO breach events.

dave: Once dashboard is up I'll post the grafana link here and add to the SLO runbook.

anika: I'll add a note in the PR about backward-compatibility and include migration steps for alerting.

maria: Thanks all — let's re-check here on Thu for progress. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :rocket:
